comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 returns 1 when any comment explicitly engages with a specific example or premise cited in the OP's argument. The engagement can be of any kind (address, accept, build on), and it need not be critical or personal. Feature 1 returns 1 only when a comment describes a real-world personal experience of the commenter or someone they know and sets it against the OP's view. Feature 1 excludes hypotheticals and statistics and is not tied to a specific OP example or premise. The two features have different eligibility rules and different positive conditions, and the sources only match in name. A comment that engages an OP premise without personal experience scores 1 on feature 0 and 0 on feature 1.
